products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public enterprise software company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, CA. According to its website, the company describes itself as an "Enterprise AI Platform for HR, Finance, and IT" and promotes Sana and agentic AI capabilities. The company states that its AI enables users to "activate teams of specialized agents to perform key processes across HR, finance, and IT" and emphasizes agents that "find, build, act, and automate." Workday reported revenue of $9,552,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026.

The company offers Workday AI, categorized as ERP and Business Application AI, which focuses on HR and finance AI, skills-based talent management, and predictive analytics. The site notes potential exposure of sensitive HR data.

Workday has substantial litigation exposure, with nine cases tracked across multiple federal district courts including the Eastern District of California, Northern District of Georgia, Northern District of California, District of Colorado, District of Maryland, and Eastern District of Virginia. The company shows particular law exposure in California, with 208 tracked matters in that state.
